title: Unit Event — Our Happy Ending — Episode7 Chasing Dreams Together

meta.Event Outline: Following the successful 30th Anniversary Show, the Wonderlands×Showtime cast feel renewed determination for their respective dreams. Emu, realizing that the troupe will part ways sooner or later, attempts to put on a brave face and say goodbye with a smile. Meanwhile, Rui makes a bold proposition to the Otori brothers.

rows.Line: Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, we're just about finished cleaning the stage, so let's start heading home.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay!
Get home safe, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Are you not walking with us to the main gate, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Not today!
I just got a message from my brothers... They're coming here to meet me in a bit!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see... Then, we'll see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, Emu...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The taiyaki place we always go to started selling ones with a strawberry milk flavored filling yesterday. Let's go grab some tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well then, farewell!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Stretch*
We had another really fun practice today! Everyone sounded so excited about our show!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Probably because of the one Miku and the others put on for us, huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It was so good...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: KAITO and the others did a wonderhoy job as the troupe members.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And they even changed the ending.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They went their separate ways, but all came back together...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What do I do...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They won't stop...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm Emu Otori!
Welcome to the fantastic Wonder Stage, a place filled with lots of smiles!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's put on some incredible shows together, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh...? Wh-Whaaaaaat?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What the heck is going on?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Say hello to our new stage director!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow! You're the performer from yesterday!
Welcome, and wonderhoy☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hmm... I didn't know about this stage.
It's old, but well-maintained.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You must be the other cast member Tsukasa mentioned. I'm Rui Kamishiro. Nice to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Little Robot, do you have a name?

rows.Speaker: Robot
rows.Line: A name... Um...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Come to think of it, we haven't named the robot.
Could you tell them your name instead this time?

rows.Speaker: Robot
rows.Line:
...
Nene Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The show Miku and the others put on for us today was extraordinary.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, it certainly was.
Their thoughtfulness really knows no bounds.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We may be going our separate ways now, but we can still be together again someday... At least, that's the message I heard.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, me too...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I feel a lot better about what's ahead after seeing their show.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Do you think Emu's gonna be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She had her usual smile during practice...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But she's also able to keep smiling for someone else's sake. Even when she's not feeling all that great...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right...
I wish there were something we could do for her...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But this time around...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I still wanna do as much stuff as I can with her. Like going home together, messaging each other and...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
I just remembered that I left my phone in the changing room...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What? Then, you need to go get it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Fortunately, we're still not very far from the Wonder Stage. Shall we head back together?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
O-Okay.
Sorry, you guys. And thanks...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Just gimme a sec.
I'll be right back.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course. Feel free to take your time since you're moving in the dark.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Did you hear something just now...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Hear what...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
Hey, that looks like...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is she...crying...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
...?!
N-Nene?! What are you doing here...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu, your face...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh? No, I...!
I wasn't crying! My eyes are just hurting because I didn't get enough sleep...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You big dummy...!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Why are you crying all by yourself?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If you're gonna cry... Then cry when we're here!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Don't you remember what I said?! What Tsukasa said?! What Rui said?! We want to do everything we can to make sure you keep smiling!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know... Unlike all those other times, our hands are tied for this one...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But if you feel sad, we should be sharing that feeling together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: At least let us do that...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But...! But...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want us to be smiling when we say goodbye to each other!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want you guys to feel happy about setting out into the world...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I don't want those smiles of yours to fade away...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Tenma, written as “soaring pegasus”!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Tsukasa, meaning to govern!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I am Tsukasa Tenma, the soaring pegasus born to rule the showbiz world!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As a future star, and as the troupe leader of Wonderlands×Showtime, I must interject!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wanting to part ways while smiling— I understand that feeling well!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We've always been surrounded by smiles and laughter.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The audience is an obvious example, but more to the point...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whenever Rui thinks up a new stunt or special effect, whenever Nene sings, whenever you talk about your big dreams, Emu...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We always find ourselves smiling and laughing. We all want each other to be happy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which is why... I understand your desire for us to keep smiling to the very end.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We don't have to right now, do we...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Us going our separate ways after having so much fun together is painful to say the least.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My heart aches so much...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, I am allowing us to all do the same!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let us take this opportunity to cry together...!!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You already are...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, didn't you hear what I just said! Now is our chance to cry together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Why are you making it into some rule...?
I was trying to have a serious conversation...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Now it all just feels stupid...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Your face is so messy now, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It looks all funny...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Look who's talking, Emu!
Your face has turned into a balled up tissue!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That makes yours a crumpled up piece of newspaper...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. This is so strange...
We're all crying, but laughing at the same time...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This situation captures us so well...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It does...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you for asking me to join you that time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're the reason I've been able to make such wonderful friends, and pursue my dream.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can't thank you enough...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: *Cry*
Emu, are you there...?
No, wait...
Hm? Why?
It looks like they're somewhat preoccupied...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I regret not doing this a little sooner...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Hey, all of you!
Sorry, but we need to talk!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?! Wh-What's going on?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Shosuke...?!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We were planning to speak with Emu first...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: But since you're all together, we'll say it all right here.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Say it all...?
What is it?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: This is about what matters the most to all of you.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: As Emu's brothers, we want to respect her wishes.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Regardless of whether or not she decided to stay, we planned to support her choice.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Hearing her decision caused us to begin doubting ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: We weren't sure if this would be what's best for her. A lot of things started going through our minds, including whether we'd regret this down the road...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: And in the end, we don't believe this is what's best.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's not...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, what do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Go.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We understand your wish to protect Phoenix Wonderland and keep it filled with smiles.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Obviously, that makes us happy as the operators of this park, and your passion would make you a valuable member of our team.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: But you're still just a high schooler...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: You should be seeing what the outside world has to offer.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: The time you have now... What you experience during your youth will surely benefit you down the road in terms of both your dream and your life as a whole.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
And of course...
It will help Phoenix Wonderland in the future.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Think about this, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Before we became this park's operators, we traveled to more places than you can imagine.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: In particular, we got ourselves introduced to the world of show business. And not just theatre. We went around learning as much as we could about the film and animation industries.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I wouldn't say that all of what we saw is helping us with our current jobs. However, I can say that it made us who we are now as professionals...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Yes, really.
And can you guess who suggested that we do that...?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: It was Grandpa.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: And once what you've seen here has made you smile, you should take a look at the world around you...

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: Unfortunately, unlike what you see on stage, it's not all full of smiles and happiness.

rows.Speaker: Rakunosuke
rows.Line: But I'm sure what you witness will become the fuel that drives you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: If you truly wish to protect this place... Go out and expand your horizons, and then return.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Until then, we'll keep an eye on Phoenix Wonderland for you.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Because your dream has also become our dream.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Shosuke...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Y-Yes...?!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Thank you for doing your best to not interfere with our business. That was very considerate of you.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: However, this is also an important time for you. There's no need for you to shape your thoughts based on our needs...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We'll do everything in our power to make sure this park keeps growing. To make sure Phoenix Wonderland stays filled with smiles.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: And if you still genuinely wish to perform here again someday...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
You'll be more than welcome.
We promise to reward you handsomely.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Are you sure about this...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes. This is what we've decided.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Nene
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Won't you join us, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As a humble actor, I am in no position to make any claims regarding what your brothers just said.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: All I have to say is...that I want to keep doing shows with you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I mean that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Emu...
Please allow me to ask you again.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I truly wish to keep doing shows with this troupe. I mean every word of that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If there's a way for you to pursue your dream as we pursue ours, won't you be willing to reconsider our invitation...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He's right, Emu...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Come with us!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I don't ever want to break the promise I made to Grandpa...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But...
If there's a way that lets me protect this park and go with you guys...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Go, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We'll be eagerly awaiting your return.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay...!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna go with them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna go out there and learn as much as I can! And I'm gonna find a way to fill this park with even more smiles!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry, everyone...
I didn't mean to make you all worry so much about me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
What are you saying? There's no need for you to apologize to us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
She's right!
“Sorry” isn't what we want to hear right now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks for letting me come with you!

source: https://storage.sekai.best/sekai-en-assets/event_story/…（SEKAI master database + SEKAI Viewer 资源，官方文本）
